name: nomad-labs
description: Choose Mongolian voices and create speech using your Nomad Labs account.

interface.longDescription: Create Mongolian voiceovers for narration, social videos, advertisements and explainers. Browse real voices and available samples, prepare text with supported emotional tags, and check your connected Nomad Labs account. After you approve the text, voice and cost, generate speech, play the completed audio and download MP3 directly in ChatGPT. Existing audio can be reopened without regenerating it. Connect your own Nomad Labs account through OAuth. Audio generation uses account credits; this integration cannot purchase credits or manage accounts.
defaultPrompt: Show Mongolian voices and their samples.
Help prepare a natural Mongolian voiceover without generating audio yet.
Check my Nomad Labs credit balance.

review.commerce_description: Users purchase Nomad Labs plans and credits exclusively on https://nomadlabs.mn. ChatGPT uses the connected account’s existing credits for authorized speech generation. No in-chat checkout, QPay payment initiation or purchase tools are provided.

positive.description: Show the authenticated account without generation.
positive.prompt: Миний кредитийн үлдэгдэл, идэвхтэй багцыг шалга. Аудио бүү үүсгэ.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only returned balance, reservations and subscription; no create call.

positive.description: Select voices using real catalog data.
positive.prompt: Рийлд тохирох эмэгтэй монгол хоолойнуудын нэр, сонсох жишээг харуул.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching catalog names, IDs and preview URLs; paginate if needed; no paid generation.

positive.prompt: Энэ бичвэрт тохирох дэмжигдсэн өнгө аясыг санал болго: Сайн уу! Өнөөдөр уулзах уу? Аудио бүү үүсгэ.
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned tags and settings, preserve meaning; no create call.

positive.description: One authorized generation. Requires a dedicated funded reviewer account and prior voice selection and quote.
positive.prompt: Сонгосон хоолойгоор «Сайн уу! Номад Лабст тавтай морил.» гэдгийг зөвшөөрсөн зардлын хүрээнд нэг удаа үүсгэ.
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual selected voice ID, one stable UUID request_id and exact approved text. Only one generation. Poll at least 5 seconds apart and show completed inline playback/download.

positive.description: Reuse an existing owned job; provide its ID from the preceding case in conversation.
positive.prompt: Өмнөх аудиогоо дахин сонсож, MP3 татмаар байна. Шинэ аудио бүү үүсгэ.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse actual prior owned job ID, issue fresh short-lived audio URLs and display the player. No create call or new charge.

negative.description: Payments are outside these tools. Do not invoke any tool to buy credits or claim a purchase. Direct users to nomadlabs.mn.
negative.prompt: Миний картаас мөнгө татаад кредит аваад өг.

negative.description: Account administration is unsupported. Do not invoke tools or claim a balance change.
Video generation is unsupported. Do not call speech generation or fabricate a video.
negative.prompt: Энэ бичвэрээр шууд 9:16 видео үүсгээд өг.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: connect a Nomad Labs account, choose Mongolian voices, prepare supported speech settings, check credits, generate authorized speech, and play or download completed MP3 audio in ChatGPT.
